messages:
tara_ap: Heads up - international vendor OliverTech sent invoice OT-778 with UK VAT charged. Vendor name on invoice is "OliverTech Ltd" but there's no UTR/VAT shown. Can vendor confirm VAT reg number and confirm where services were supplied (UK or remote)?

oliver_vendor: Sorry team, we're registered in UK but our VAT number is GB987654321. The supply was actually performed by our Cyprus team (remote dev), looks like billing team defaulted to UK VAT. We'll check.

mike_tax: If supply is to a UK business and service supplied in UK, VAT applies. But if billed to Redwood UK VAT-registered entity and service is cross-border B2B (EEA/Cyprus) reverse charge may apply. @tara_ap who is the billed entity?

tara_ap: Billed to Redwood Ltd (UK). I'll confirm VAT ID and share.

acctbot: Payment hold: missing vendor VAT number and supply location.

karla_ops: @oliver_vendor please reissue with the correct VAT number and indicate place of supply. If reverse-charge applies, issue invoice without VAT and show "reverse charge" on the invoice.

mike_tax: Also confirm whether any withholding (e.g., Cyprus withholding) is applicable. For software dev services typically none, but confirm with vendor whether any local withholding was applied.

oliver_vendor: Thanks, we'll reissue. No local withholding applied on our side. New invoice incoming.

tara_ap: Great, once we have corrected invoice AP will proceed.
